messages:
zoe: opened a PR to update the Lyra7B model card with compatibility notes, seq_ceiling, and an SDK v4 snippet showing per-request fallback controls. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/10021

ali: thanks Zoe. can you call out the q4 variant behavior? I remember lyra7b-q4 drops attention precision and loses some long-context coherence. we should recommend 'fallback_capable: conditional' with a short rationale.

zoe: added a line: 'lyra7b-q4: lower cost but reduced long-context coherence; avoid for >2048 token sessions'. also added `fallback_constraints` in the YAML sample. pasted the YAML in the PR: 

```yaml
# model card additions
name: lyra7b
variants:
  - lyra7b
  - lyra7b-q4
compatibility:
  fallback_capable: conditional
  fallback_constraints: "short-context only; seq_ceiling: 2048; kv_cache_sensitive: true"
```

marta: can you include a tiny benchmark summary? ops wants numbers for P50/P95 and cost delta when falling back to q4. a small CSV excerpt is fine.

zoe: pasted a public excerpt in the PR body: "p50_latency_ms,p95_latency_ms,cost_per_token_usd
primary: 85,220,0.00045
q4_variant: 95,410,0.00027". left the full CSV as internal-only in comments. noted: q4 gives ~40% cost reduction but P95 increases ~190ms on dedicated pools.

ali: nice. please also add the SDK v4 snippet showing per-request opt-out and fallback_strategy so customers can pin or prefer variants.

zoe: added snippet below in the PR: 

```js
// SDK v4: per-request fallback controls
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });

await client.generate({
  model: 'lyra7b@2026-05-01',
  input: 'Summarize the release notes.',
  options: { max_tokens: 300 },
  routing: {
    allow_fallback: true, // set false to forbid fallback for this call
    fallback_strategy: 'cost-first', // 'latency-first' | 'cost-first'
    fallback: ['lyra7b-q4@2026-05-01']
  }
});
```

runtime-ci: running docs checks for PR #10021: CSV internal link flagged (403). Snippet-lint OK. YAML lint: compatibility.seq_ceiling missing (non-fatal) but you have seq_ceiling inside `fallback_constraints` string. consider normalizing to an integer field.

zoe: good call. normalized YAML to explicitly include `seq_ceiling: 2048` as integer and left `fallback_constraints` as human note. pushed update.

ali: one more ask from eng-ml: can we add a short sentence about quantized variant accuracy implications? just "q4 variants may show lower factuality on long multi-turn prompts" is fine.

zoe: added that sentence and referenced the evaluation notebook in internal storage. pasted a short public note and kept the notebook link internal.

docs-bot: link-check queued. external links OK. repo links OK. internal S3 link flagged as internal-only. no blocking issues.

marta: editorial nit: change 'lower-cost variant' -> 'lower-cost variant (quantized)'. small wording polish.

zoe: updated wording. added a merge checklist in PR body: 1) eng-ml approval (ali), 2) docs review (marta), 3) snippet smoke test in examples repo, 4) run link-check successful.

ali: reviewing now. LGTM pending one tiny addition: include an example log line showing runtime event when fallback triggers (helps docs readers find traces).

zoe: added example log in PR: `routing.fallback_used from=lyra7b to=lyra7b-q4 reason=capacity_pool_burst`.

runtime-ci: performed a quick canary run on staging; fallback event emitted as expected and log included in CI artifacts.

docs-bot: final checks passed. PR #10021 merged.

marta: great. can someone file a follow-up to sweep other 7B cards for `seq_ceiling` and `fallback_capable`? I'll add it to the docs board.

ali: filing sweep task now. thanks Zoe and Marta. closing thread.
